notes.title: Bug Fix Notice (2025.05.17)
notes.content:
HELLO LUCKY HEROES
  
Thank you for your feedback. Based on your opinions and suggestions, we have fixed the following issues:

1. Dream Park
(1) Fixed an issue that could occasionally prevent minigames from being published in Dream Builder.

2. Online Party
(1) Fixed an issue where players could not cancel Star Party signups after finishing in an AnyTime AnyWhere match.
(2) Fixed an issue in the minigame Jump Rope where characters would be suspended in mid-air before the countdown began.

III. Esports 
(1) Fixed an issue where all participants were displayed as "Seed No.0" for a moment during tournament draws.
(2) An issue that caused avatars on the Tourney schedule interface to become blank has been fixed.

IV. Issues with Game Launch on Some Language Systems
There are currently issues with OS support for French, German, and Portuguese. We are actively working on a fix; in the meantime, you may switch your computer's format to English in Control Panel > Region > Format or wait for the hotfix. Please stay tuned to our community for updates.

Keep enjoying your time in Cube Planet! We will continue collecting feedback.
Your Loyal Dev Team: Thunderfire Universe X Studio (TUXS)

notes.title: Planet Party Time's First Technical Test Update Notice
notes.content:
Dear heroes,

Welcome to our 5-day technical test! We are very excited to announce the following:

(1) Servers have been set up in the following areas:
North America, Japan, and some parts of Europe. We will continue to add more in subsequent tests.


(2) Users from the above regions who recieve an invitation to the test can download the game 1 day in advance through Steam.
Users can start downloading at:
EDT: 05/14 at 12:00 (UTC-4)
PDT: 05/14 at 09:00 (UTC-7)
JST: 05/15 at 01:00 (UTC+9)


(3) Game servers will be live during the following times:
EDT: 05/15 at 12:00 (UTC-4) - 05/20 at 11:59 (UTC-4)
PDT: 05/15 09:00 (UTC-7) - 05/20 at 08:59 (UTC-7)
JST: 05/16 at 01:00 (UTC+9) - 05/21 at 00:59 (UTC+9)
During the test, we will be running a 120 hour dev marathon stream. Come exploer the Cube Galaxy with us, and talk to the devs face-to-face!

(4) We have prepared 100 20$ Amazon gift cards for players who participate in the test:
Please follow our DISCORD community for event details.
Tap here to join Discord:https://discord.com/invite/ppt/

Hope you enjoy your game!

Your loyal dev team: ThunderFire Universe X Studio (TUXS)

notes.title: Planet Party Time First Gameplay Test Announcement
notes.content:
Planet Party Time is opening a First Gameplay Test starting in May. In the First Gameplay Test, players will have access to the unique sim & party gameplay experience.

If you yearn to role-play as a fluffy companion among the planets and build your own world, be sure to sign up from Steam page: Planet Party Time Stream Store Page

Test Period
The First Gameplay Test will start on May 15th PT & ET | May 16th JST and continues until May 19th PT & ET | May 20th JST. 

Where can I play the First Gameplay Test
The First Gameplay Test will be available on PC via Steam.
Planet Party Time welcomes everyone to join!

How to Join
The store page is now live! Visit Planet Party Time Steam Store Page and add to your wishlist and register for First Gameplay Test. You'll receive a notification when the test begins starting on May 15th, the game will be available for download.

Will progress be reset after test end
After the First Gameplay Test ends on May 19th PT & ET | May 20th JST, the progress from the First Gameplay Test will be reset.

What content I can expect?
Experience the completed game content, including the social simulation game and a powerful level editor.

For more information about Planet Party Time, check out and follow our official social channels.
